files.policy/expense-policy.md:
# Expense policy (revision 4, approved 3 February 2026)

Scope: reimbursable costs incurred by employees while travelling for work
and while working from a registered home workplace.

## Hotel stays
Reimburse the actual invoice up to EUR 180.00 per night. Above the cap,
attach the budget owner's approval before booking.

## Meals while travelling
A flat EUR 52.80 per day is paid for calendar days with an overnight stay.
Alcohol is never reimbursable.

## Mobile voice plans
Employees with a company phone may claim EUR 24.50 per month of the
personal subscription fee. Data-only SIMs are not covered.

## Home office equipment
Desks, chairs and monitors for a registered home workplace are reimbursed
once per three-year cycle up to EUR 350.00, receipts attached.

## Coworking day passes
Day passes up to EUR 31.00 are reimbursed with the venue invoice.
files.policy/travel-booking-guide.md:
# Travel booking guide

Book rail before air for single-leg trips under 400 km, and make every
booking through the corporate portal so the invoice lands in the archive.

Changes made less than 24 hours before departure need a short written note
from the budget owner; the travel desk cannot process them otherwise.

Questions: travel desk, building 1, desk 12.
files.readme.md:
# Finance documents

The expense policy is the binding reference for reimbursements; the travel
booking guide only covers how trips are booked.
